name: Startup Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Startup Lithuania's expert panel must assess the business idea as genuinely innovative -- a scalable, technology-driven concept, not a relocation disguised as a startup.
requirements.fix_path: Submit a business plan for Startup Lithuania's innovation assessment.

requirements.blocker_text: Means of subsistence of at least EUR 1,038/month (EUR 12,456/year), evidenced by bank statements or proof of income.
Health insurance coverage of at least EUR 30,000, valid across the EU for 12 months and including repatriation costs.

evidence_required.document: Business plan submitted to Startup Lithuania
Bank statements proving means of subsistence

outcome.duration_length: 2 years initially, extendable by a further 3 years

sources.title: Corpenza -- Lithuania Startup Visa: Startup Lithuania expert-panel innovation assessment, EUR 1,038/month subsistence requirement, EUR 30,000 health insurance, 2-year initial + 3-year extension, 120-day company-formation deadline post-approval

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Lithuania). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to a specialist relocation-consultancy guide rather than an independently fetched tier-1 startuplithuania.com or migracija.lt page in this pass (the latter returned only a JavaScript shell on direct fetch). The EUR 1,038/month figure is described as tied to Lithuania's official minimum-subsistence-level calculation, which is periodically updated -- treated here as a snapshot figure, not independently re-verified against a tier-1 source. Approved founders must register the company within 120 days and notify Startup Lithuania within 3 working days of registration, per the source -- disclosed as a process detail rather than modeled as a testable requirement.
